title: Driver and Incident Surcharges, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Rate Page
content:
Surcharges on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy are percentages of the base premium. Each package carries its own surcharge percentages, its own lookback, and its own forgiveness features.

## Surcharge rates by package

| Item | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Youthful driver surcharge, per youthful rated driver | 45% | 40% | 35% | 30% | 28% | 25% |
| Youthful driver age limit (a rated driver younger than this is youthful), years | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 | 25 |
| At-fault accident surcharge, per chargeable at-fault accident | 40% | 35% | 30% | 30% | 25% | 20% |
| Minimum paid on an at-fault accident for it to be chargeable, USD | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Major violation surcharge, per major violation | 60% | 70% | 80% | 80% | 90% | 90% |
| Minor violation surcharge, per minor violation | 20% | 18% | 15% | 12% | 10% | 10% |
| Lookback before the rating date in which incidents count, months | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 |

## Forgiveness features by package

| Feature | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accident forgiveness included | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Months of continuous Cardinal coverage the named insured needs on the accident date for accident forgiveness | not read | not read | not read | 36 | 24 | 0 |
| Minor violation forgiveness included | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |

Accident forgiveness, where included, means the first chargeable at-fault accident in the lookback is forgiven and not surcharged, provided the named insured had at least the stated months of continuous Cardinal coverage on the accident date. The tenure figure is read only on packages that include accident forgiveness; on Cardinal Auto Premier it is 0, so any named insured qualifies. Minor violation forgiveness, where included, means the first minor violation in the lookback is forgiven and not surcharged.

## Notes on the definitions

- An at-fault accident counts toward the surcharge only when the amount paid on it is at or above the minimum shown (1000 on every package). Hypothetical: an at-fault accident with 999.99 paid is not chargeable; one with 1000.00 paid is.
- A driver is youthful while younger than 25 on the rating date. Hypothetical: a rated driver aged 24 is youthful; one who turned 25 on or before the rating date is not.
- The lookback is the 36 calendar months ending on the rating date, counted by the incident date.
